# BlenderSky

The sky models of Blender's `intern/sky`, unmodified, from Blender commit fbe6228777e7d9afefcd61a413844e790ae75db7:

- `source/sky_single_scattering.cpp`: Apache-2.0
- `source/sky_multiple_scattering.cpp`: MIT
- `source/sky_hosek.cpp`, `source/sky_hosek_data.h`, `include/sky_hosek.h`: BSD-3-Clause

Blender's `sky_math.h` and `sky_nishita.h` are GPL-2.0-or-later, so they are not here. NoorRay's own replacements are in `external/Compat/BlenderSky`.
